description: This file defines the NotesAdapter class for managing and displaying a list of Note objects in a RecyclerView, including filtering functionality.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding Note data to RecyclerView, with filtering support.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.NoteViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for Note item views.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.OnItemClickListener
classes.description: Interface for handling click events on Note items.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Replaces current notes with a new list and updates the display.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters notes based on a query string.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for a note item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes currently displayed.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the item view UI elements and sets click listeners.
